data.name: Delegation Not Permitted
data.payload: {"status":403, "message": "delegation_not_permitted", "detail":"This subject is not authorized to operate this agent"}

data.name: Include all attributes
data.description: Allows a client to read any attribute.

data.name: Include email attributes
data.description: Allows to read specific email address attributes. Note that these attributes are schema-specific and may need to be changed to reflect your user schema.

data.name: Include profile attributes
data.description: Allows a client to read a set of specific user profile attributes. Note that these attributes are schema-specific and may need to be changed to reflect your user schema.

data.name: Insufficient Scope
data.description: For use when a policy denies a request because the bearer token scopes do not authorize the client to access the requested resource.
data.payload: {"status":403, "message":"insufficient_scope", "detail":"Requested operation not allowed by the granted OAuth scopes."}

data.name: Invalid Token
data.description: For use when a policy denies a request because the access token is inactive, expired, or otherwise invalid.
data.payload: {"status":401, "message": "invalid_token", "detail":"Access token is expired or otherwise invalid"}

data.name: Optimize SCIM searches
data.description: When included in the decision for a SCIM2 policy request with the 'search' action, directs the PingAuthorize to authorize and filter search results using a single policy request with the 'search-results' action. This advice type does not require a payload.

data.name: Unauthorized Audience
data.description: For use when a policy denies a request because the access token audience is incorrect for the requested service.
data.payload: {"status":403, "message":"invalid_token", "detail":"The access token was issued for a different audience."}

data.name: Unauthorized Client
data.description: For use when a policy denies a request because the client is not authorized to access the requested resource.
data.payload: {"status":401,"detail":"unauthorized_client","message":"The client is not authorized to request this resource."}
